summary: Iteration 2 E2E testing complete. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests pass (added 15 new tests for suppliers CRUD, orders lifecycle with close-to-stock-in, reports/by-supplier aggregation, stock-in with supplier_id, daily-digest trigger, and auth protection on all 6 new endpoints). Frontend: login → sidebar shows Tedarikçiler + Siparişler → supplier create/card visible → order create with 2-column supplier/product selects + qty/price → 'Kapat & Stoğa İşle' triggers stock-in movements and increments product stock → StockIn si-qr opens scanner (qr-close visible), si-supplier dropdown populated → StockOut so-qr opens scanner. PWA: manifest.json + sw.js both return 200; index.html includes <link rel='manifest'> and apple-mobile-web-app-capable meta. APScheduler started successfully on backend startup (logs confirm 'Scheduler started: daily digest at 08:00 Europe/Istanbul'). Daily-digest email endpoint returned {ok:true} (Emergent Resend accepted with 202).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — same as iteration 1; caused by build-tooling injecting x-* metadata <span> inside <option> in StockIn, StockOut, Orders selects. Non-blocking, functional.

action_items: (Optional) Consider fixing/removing dev-tool x-* attribute injection into <option> tags to eliminate console hydration warnings (build-tool concern, not app logic).
(Optional) server.py is now 937 lines — well past the 700-line soft cap; strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, products, personnel, machines, stock, suppliers, orders, reports, scheduler).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from 648 → 937 lines; split into APIRouter modules soon to keep maintainability.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context (also matters for scheduler).
close_order iterates items sequentially with awaits — for large orders could be batched; not critical.
close_order silently continues if a product was deleted mid-order (uses 'continue'); consider recording the skipped product in response so UI can warn.
CORS allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True remains (from iter 1) — tighten for production.

send_daily_digest email failure is swallowed via try/except; that's fine for scheduler but manual /admin/send-daily-digest also returns ok:true even on send failure — consider surfacing status in response for admins testing.
seed_data_creation: Test suppliers/orders created inline with TEST_/TESTUI_ prefix; cleaned up after each test. One leftover TEST_Supplier_ac828a observed from a prior aborted run — minor cosmetic residue; can be manually purged if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. All iteration 1 + iteration 2 tests green (37/37). SupplierIn uses 'contact_person' not 'contact'. Orders items must have quantity>0. close_order is idempotent-guarded (409 pattern via 400). QR scanner opens a dialog with data-testid='qr-close' — can't test camera itself headlessly.
